# SUPEREKA

> SUPEREKA is a Singapore building services consultancy, founded in 2018, providing air-conditioning and mechanical ventilation (ACMV), electrical, fire protection, Qualified Person (QP) endorsement, project management and due diligence services, in Singapore and overseas.

SUPEREKA is a building services (M&E) consultancy based in Singapore, founded in 2018 by architects and mechanical and electrical engineers. It serves building owners, developers, builders and homeowners.

Legal name: SUPEREKA LLP (UEN T18LL1787A)
Contact: admin@supereka-sg.com | +65 9667 4754
Address: National Design Centre, 111 Middle Road, #03-01, Singapore 188969

## Services
- [Air-Conditioning & Mechanical Ventilation Services (ACMV)](https://supereka-sg.com/services/acmv/): Design and supervision of air-conditioning and mechanical ventilation systems for offices, retail, F&B, central kitchens, homes and places of worship in Singapore.
- [Electrical Services](https://supereka-sg.com/services/electrical/): Electrical design, load assessment and Licensed Electrical Worker (LEW) services, including electrical load upgrading and EV charging infrastructure in Singapore.
- [Fire Protection Services](https://supereka-sg.com/services/fire-protection/): Fire protection system design and regulatory submissions for new and existing buildings in Singapore.
- [Qualified Person (QP) Endorsement](https://supereka-sg.com/services/qualified-person-endorsement/): Endorsement of building services plans and submissions for BCA, SCDF and other regulatory approvals in Singapore.
- [Project Management](https://supereka-sg.com/services/project-management/): Project management and construction supervision for building services works, from design through to completion.
- [Due Diligence](https://supereka-sg.com/services/due-diligence/): Building services due diligence for owners, buyers and tenants who need an independent view of a building's mechanical and electrical systems.

## Projects
- [All projects](https://supereka-sg.com/projects/): 61+ projects across 7 sectors and HDB neighbourhood upgrading, including 19 outlets for a leading premium tea brand and 11 central kitchens.
- [Outlet rollout for a leading premium tea brand](https://supereka-sg.com/projects/fnb-outlets/): Building services consultancy for 19 outlets of a leading premium tea brand across Singapore, plus the brand's head office.
- [Central kitchens for the food delivery supply chain](https://supereka-sg.com/projects/central-kitchens/): Design specifications for 11 multi-stall central kitchens across Singapore, supporting the regional food delivery supply chain.
- [Public housing neighbourhood upgrading](https://supereka-sg.com/projects/hdb-neighbourhood-upgrading/): M&E design and construction supervision for HDB Neighbourhood Renewal Programme works and covered linkway upgrading across Singapore.
- [Mosques and temples: upgrading historic buildings](https://supereka-sg.com/projects/places-of-worship/): Additions and alterations to two mosques and a temple in Singapore, upgrading facilities in the least invasive way possible.
- [Landed homes with efficient building services](https://supereka-sg.com/projects/residential/): Energy-efficient ACMV and electrical design for five new landed homes in Singapore, including pools and smart-home infrastructure.
- [Offices, restaurants and hospitality venues](https://supereka-sg.com/projects/commercial/): Building services for seven commercial and hospitality projects, from a waterfront restaurant to offices and a fitness gym.
- [Office design and management, in Singapore and overseas](https://supereka-sg.com/projects/offices/): Office design and management for companies in Singapore and overseas, including projects in South Korea and the Philippines.
- [Vetting and regulatory submissions](https://supereka-sg.com/projects/regulatory-submissions/): Vetting and submission of building services designs to landlords and authorities, including a PUB submission with QP endorsement of calculations.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2018
